2608.29301.title: Predicting Future Organ Dysfunction in ICU Patients Using Temporal Convolutional Networks on MIMIC-IV Data
2608.29301.paper_summary: Predicting future organ dysfunction in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) patients is critical for early clinical intervention, yet existing machine learning approaches have largely treated the Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score as an input to binary mortality prediction rather than as a continuous clinical outcome in its own right. We investigate the extent to which a Temporal Convolutional Net work (TCN) can predict next-day SOFA scores from multivariate ICU time-series data extracted from MIMIC-IV, characterise the relative contribution of each organ system to total SOFA variance and deterioration, and identify distinct trajectory patterns across ICU stays. A residual TCN trained on three-day sliding windows achieved a five-fold cross-validation R2 of 0.740 +- 0.013 and MAE of 1.431 +- 0.022, outperforming a naive persistence baseline on RMSE and R2. SHAP interpretability analysis revealed that the model functions primarily as a severity-anchoring mechanism rather than a true sequence model, with predictions dominated almost entirely by the most recent observation day. Cardiovascular dysfunction emerged as the strongest discriminator of both cross-sectional severity and acute deterioration, and unsupervised trajectory clustering identified two clinically meaningful phenotypes, an improving group (58.9%) and a persistently severe group (41.1%), differentiated by cardiovascular, hepatic, coagulation, and renal involvement. We conclude that TCNs can extract meaningful predictive signal from ICU physiological data, but that short input windows and complete-case selection bias currently limit their clinical utility, motivating future work on longer input horizons, alternative missing-data strategies, and external validation.
2608.29301.paper_summary_zh: 預測重症監護病房（ICU）患者未來的器官功能障礙對於早期臨床干預至關重要，然而現有的機器學習方法在很大程度上將序列器官功能評估（SOFA）分數視為二元死亡率預測的輸入，而不是作為一個持續的臨床結果。我們研究了時間卷積網絡（TCN）在多變量ICU時間序列數據中，從MIMIC-IV提取的數據中預測次日SOFA分數的程度，表徵每個器官系統對總SOFA變異和惡化的相對貢獻，並識別ICU住院期間的不同軌跡模式。基於三天滑動窗口訓練的殘差TCN達到了五倍交叉驗證R2為0.740 ± 0.013和MAE為1.431 ± 0.022，在RMSE和R2上超越了天真的持續基線。SHAP可解釋性分析顯示，該模型主要作為一種嚴重程度錨定機制，而不是一個真正的序列模型，預測幾乎完全由最近的觀察日主導。心血管功能障礙成為橫斷面嚴重程度和急性惡化的最強區分因子，而無監督的軌跡聚類識別出兩種臨床意義明確的表型，一個是改善組（58.9%），另一個是持續重度組（41.1%），兩者之間的區別在於心血管、肝臟、凝血和腎臟的參與。我們得出結論，TCN可以從ICU生理數據中提取有意義的預測信號，但短輸入窗口和完整案例選擇偏差目前限制了它們的臨床實用性，這促使未來在更長的輸入時間範圍、替代缺失數據策略和外部驗證方面進行進一步研究。
